name: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS: LANCES OF THE CRIMSON KEEP
description:
This boxed set provides a mobile Soulblight Gravelords force for use in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar, and is suitable for starting a new collection or expanding an existing army. Purchasing this set offers a cost saving compared to buying the included kits separately.

This boxed set builds 14 multipart plastic Soulblight Gravelords miniatures:

    1x Prince Vhordrai, Lord of the Crimson Keep (which can alternatively be built as a Revenant Draconith)
    3x Fell Bats
    10x Blood Knights

The miniatures in this kit offer multiple customisation options. The Fell Bats feature interchangeable heads across all three bodies.

This kit comprises 216 plastic components, 1x Citadel 160mm Round Base, 3x Citadel 40mm Round Bases, and 10x Citadel 75mm by 41.5mm Oval Bases.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted

This boxed set is available while stocks last.
